hub.title: Data warehouse
hub.description: Manage archived dossiers, submissions, review, field configuration, and ACL permissions in one place.
hub.noPermission: You do not have permission to access the data warehouse.

hubNav.expiryReviewDescription: Review expiring, expired, and duplicate dossiers

page.title: Archive dossier management
page.description: Search across assigned fonds or pick a fond to browse archived dossiers in your scope.
page.searchPlaceholder: Search by dossier name or file content...
page.crossFondSearchPlaceholder: Full-text search across all assigned fonds...
page.fondListEmpty: No fonds are available in your assigned scope.
page.selectDossierTypeFirst: Select a dossier type to browse archived dossiers.
page.selectDocumentTypeFirst: Select a document type to browse archived documents.
page.dossierTypeEmpty: This dossier type has no archived dossiers yet.
page.documentTypeEmpty: This document type has no archived documents yet.
page.documentSearchPlaceholder: Search by document or dossier name...
page.selectFondFirst: Select a fond to browse archived dossiers, or use the filters above for cross-fond search.
page.unassignedDossiersDescription: Dossiers already stored in the warehouse but not assigned to any fond.
page.fondEmpty: This fond has no archived dossiers yet.
page.unifiedSearchHint: Searching by dossier name and document content.
page.fondDossiersDescription: List and statistics of archived dossiers in this fond.

filters.title: Search filters
filters.selectDateHint: Select a start date, then an end date (you can change month/year)
filters.selectEndDateHint: Continue by selecting an end date (you can change month/year)
filters.andHint: Criteria are combined with AND (all must match).

export.title: Export dossiers
export.description: {{count}} dossiers selected. Choose an export format.
export.defaultPresetHint: One column per field, with row numbers and display-name headers.
export.selectedPresetHint: Export using the selected template columns.
export.noWatermarkHint: PDFs in the export package will not be watermarked.
export.selectedWatermarkHint: Apply the selected watermark to PDFs in the export package.
export.watermarkRequiredHint: You only have permission to download watermarked files. Please select a watermark.
export.noPlacementsAvailable: No watermark placements available. Contact your administrator.
export.activeWatermarkHint: PDFs will automatically use the active watermark configuration.
export.originalDownloadHint: Export original PDFs (no watermark). Allowed by the dossier security level.
export.securityLevelDownloadHint: Watermark and ZIP encryption follow each dossier's security level settings.
export.metadataOptionDescription: Export descriptive metadata fields as a ZIP file
export.dipOptionDescription: Export DIP package as a ZIP file
export.passwordDescription: Enter the password to unlock “{{name}}” and continue the download.
export.filePasswordDescription: One or more files in the export require a password. Enter it to continue.
export.levelPasswordDescription: One or more files belong to another security level. Enter the level password to continue.
export.passwordRetryFailed: The newly verified access could not be used. Please start the download again.
export.fileLimitExceeded: Export exceeds the limit of {{limit}} files (currently {{count}} files). Please select fewer dossiers.

detail.title: Archived dossier detail
detail.fileLockedHint: This file belongs to a higher security level and requires separate verification.
detail.fileLockedHintWithLevel: This file belongs to level {{level}} and requires separate verification.
detail.fileLockedMetadata: This file's metadata will appear after you verify the required security level.
detail.fileLockedMetadataWithLevel: This file's metadata will appear after you verify level {{level}}.
detail.fileLockedPdf: This file is locked. Enter the matching security-level password to preview the PDF.
detail.fileLockedPdfWithLevel: This file is locked (level {{level}}). Enter the matching password to preview the PDF.
detail.readOnlyHint: Read-only — editing is not available from the archive warehouse.

security.dossierDescription: Set the security level and optional dossier-specific password. A custom password overrides the level password.
security.fileDescription: Set the security level and optional password for file {{name}}.

reupload.title: Re-upload file into pipeline
reupload.description: File "{{fileName}}" will re-enter the raw → OCR → edit → approve pipeline. OCR runs only after activation on the OCR Control screen.
reupload.pipelineHint: The dossier will appear in Data management and OCR Control for end-to-end reprocessing.
reupload.pickNew: Choose a new PDF to upload
reupload.success: File sent back into the pipeline. The dossier is pending manual OCR activation on OCR Control.
reupload.failed: Failed to re-upload the file into the pipeline.

bulk.selectAll: Select all files available for bulk actions

delete.confirm: Delete file "{{fileName}}" from this dossier? The dossier will leave the warehouse and wait for manual OCR activation on OCR Control. The last file cannot be deleted.
delete.bulkConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected files? The dossier will leave the warehouse and wait for manual OCR activation on OCR Control. At least one file must remain.
delete.success: File deleted. The dossier is pending manual OCR activation on OCR Control.

move.title: Move file to another dossier
move.description: Pick a target fond and dossier for "{{fileName}}". Both dossiers will leave the warehouse and wait for manual OCR activation on OCR Control.
move.bulkDescription: Pick a target fond and dossier for the {{count}} selected files. Both dossiers will leave the warehouse and wait for manual OCR activation on OCR Control.
move.crossFondHint: Selecting a dossier in another fond. Warehouse access on the target fond is required.
move.searchPlaceholder: Search target dossier by name or id...
move.emptyFonds: No fonds are available in your assigned scope.
move.emptyTargets: No suitable target dossiers in the selected fond.
move.success: File moved. Both dossiers are pending manual OCR activation on OCR Control.
